provider_shape_boundary.condition: SSM_CONV CUDA support requires C % 128 == 0. Tiny C192 violates it; original335 C6144 satisfies this condition only, not proof of all other support or runtime success.
provider_shape_boundary.limit: The tiny CUDA process loaded 27 roles, then cold exact-variant compilation declined SSM_CONV F32 value2 before evaluation. It is neither a completed HostImage case nor evidence of a HostImage numerical failure.

case_scope: Final corrected HostImage cases are CPU3 tiny GA and CUDA4 original335 roles, each exercising ordinary and K1 modes only when its result is PASS. Preserve CPU2 earlier PASS, CUDA3 tiny unsupported-shape rejection, and CUDA3 original335 actual product coherence rejection; no CUDA tiny rerun. CUDA2 link-closure failure is preserved separately. Read actual per-role payload/byte/nonzero counts, boundary/old-alias/continuation/Model-expiry and budget-failure facts; do not infer nonzero from role presence or treat unsupported tiny shape as a HostImage numerical failure.
limits: Finite correctness and ownership evidence, no quality, latency, throughput or speedup claim.
Final MTP cases exercised lag0 with no prior-hidden payload. Lag1/prior-hidden transfer was not exercised in these cases.
Tiny GA is untrained. Raw HF RMS zero has effective gamma one; direct GDN norm zero can mask its mixed contribution. Actual full-byte and zero/nonzero facts are recorded, not assumed.

No physical-GPU pending gate/fault injection is introduced in these HostImage cases. Native failure/unknown-retirement safety is preserved by original ownership contracts; successful synchronous cases do not alone verify every fault path.
Host parking returns reusable device slots, not an automatic reduction in fixed-bank allocated VRAM. Old checkpoint aliases remain valid retainers.
Managed ResourceBudget rows/shared cap and image count are bounded; opaque driver/private native memory is explicitly outside the managed byte cap.
Apple/Vulkan complete-state transfer remains unimplemented in this common CPU/CUDA adapter; no cross-platform claim.
Archive contains only explicit small source/recipe/process/output/fixture-identity/comparison/hash metadata. No binary, SDK, model weights, full raw traces or copied prepared input library.
